case_number: 2024 INSC 840; CIVIL APPEAL No. 841 of 2018 et al.

parties.petitioner: M/s BAJAJ ALLIANCE GENERAL INSURANCE CO. LTD.

summary: License endorsement requirements for transport vehicles under Motor Vehicles Act; interpretation of Section 2(21), Section 10; whether light motor vehicle license covers transport vehicles below 7500 kg GVW; permissibility of driving transport vehicles without specific endorsement; harmonious construction of MV Act and Rules; review of Mukund Dewangan (2017) judgment; impact on road safety and drivers' livelihoods; Constitution Bench determination on statutory interpretation.
final_judgment: Constitution Bench interpretation regarding license endorsement requirements; specific determination regarding applicability of light motor vehicle license to transport vehicles under 7500 kg GVW; review of previous judgment in Mukund Dewangan (2017) upheld or modified.
